evidence: Touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp and carries the maintainer Wallet label.
rationale: Fixes an assertion failure (`!wtx.isConfirmed()`) and wallet transaction state inconsistency where confirmed transactions could be erroneously eligible for abandonment after missing connected blocks during load (fixing issue #34599). This prevents wallet crashes and incorrect transaction states following unclean shutdowns or concurrent chain advancement.
